cohort.ranking: descending SHARADAR/DAILY marketcap on baseline; ticker ascending breaks exact ties
cohort.share_class: one directly covered Sharadar fundamental representative per issuer; no market-cap copying to other classes
cohort.membership_removals: exit at next open after first inactive close

signal_price: Yahoo vendor Close with corporate-action adjustments, including composite spin-off adjustments; not a verified split-only series
account_price: Yahoo adjusted-close units; adjusted open = vendor open * adjusted close / vendor close
dividend_accounting: embedded in vendor adjusted-price proxy; no separate cash credit
capitalization: historical DAILY issuer marketcap * 1000000; same-date observation, not certified historical vintage
membership_availability: effective date treated as known at that close; historical announcement timestamps unverified

reporting.2026_ytd: NAV rebased at 2025-12-31 without resetting holdings or charging initialization again
reporting.interpretation: within-cohort retrospective comparison; not full-universe or original-protocol validation

definition_correction.reason: Source event audit identified composite spin-off ratios in Yahoo splits; this corrects the description without changing prices, signals, weights or strategy rules.
